title: Dimensional Out of Specification
description: A measured dimension such as length, width, thickness, diameter, height, or depth is outside the specified tolerance.

title: Surface Scratch / Abrasion
description: The part has an unintended scratch, scuff, gouge, or abrasion on a surface, typically caused by handling, machining, transport, or contact with another part.

title: Burr
description: An unwanted raised edge or thin piece of material remains after machining, drilling, cutting, milling, or grinding.

title: Sharp Edge
description: An edge that should be rounded, chamfered, or otherwise safe remains excessively sharp and does not meet the specified edge condition.

title: Hole Diameter Out of Specification
description: A drilled, bored, or machined hole has a diameter outside its specified tolerance.

title: Hole Position Error
description: A hole is correctly sized but is located incorrectly relative to the specified datum, pattern, or neighboring features.

title: Hole Missing
description: A required hole, bore, port, or opening has not been produced or is completely absent.

title: Hole Blocked / Obstructed
description: A required hole, passage, port, or channel exists but is partially or completely blocked by material, debris, coating, or another obstruction.

title: Thread Defect
description: An internal or external thread is damaged, incomplete, incorrectly formed, contaminated, or otherwise unable to meet its specified requirements.

title: Thread Size / Pitch Incorrect
description: The thread exists but has the wrong nominal size, pitch, thread form, or specification.

title: Flatness Out of Specification
description: A surface deviates from the required flatness tolerance, causing excessive variation across the surface.

title: Parallelism Out of Specification
description: Two surfaces or features that must be parallel have excessive angular or positional deviation.

title: Perpendicularity Out of Specification
description: A surface, hole, shaft, or feature is not sufficiently perpendicular to its reference datum or surface.

title: Concentricity / Coaxiality Error
description: Cylindrical or rotational features that should share a common axis are misaligned or have excessive eccentricity.

title: Runout Out of Specification
description: A rotating surface or feature exhibits excessive radial or axial runout when measured relative to its specified datum.

title: Warped / Distorted Part
description: The component has bent, twisted, bowed, warped, or otherwise deformed from its intended geometry.

title: Incorrect Material
description: The component was manufactured from a material that does not match the specified material grade, type, or composition.

title: Material Damage
description: The base material has cracks, dents, inclusions, voids, delamination, corrosion, or other physical damage unrelated to a specific machining operation.

title: Machining Tool Mark
description: Unintended machining marks, chatter, grooves, ridges, or tool-related patterns are present on a machined surface.

title: Poor Surface Finish
description: The measured or visually observed surface roughness or finish does not meet the specified requirement.

title: Incomplete Machining
description: A required machining operation was performed only partially, leaving excess material or an unfinished feature.

title: Over-Machined Feature
description: Too much material was removed during machining, leaving a feature below its required size or otherwise outside specification.

title: Wrong Feature Geometry
description: A feature such as a slot, pocket, chamfer, radius, contour, or profile has been produced with the wrong shape or geometry.

title: Wrong Part / Component
description: The wrong component, part number, variant, revision, or model has been selected for the operation or assembly.

title: Missing Component
description: A component, fastener, insert, seal, washer, connector, or other required item is absent from the assembly.

title: Incorrect Component Orientation
description: A component is present but installed in the wrong rotational, directional, or physical orientation.

title: Incorrect Assembly Position
description: A component is installed in the wrong location or position relative to the assembly drawing, fixture, or defined reference.

title: Incorrect Fastener
description: The installed fastener has the wrong type, size, material, head style, length, or specification.

title: Loose Fastener
description: A required fastener is installed but does not achieve the specified clamping condition, torque, preload, or retention.

title: Over-Torqued Fastener
description: A fastener was tightened beyond its specified torque or preload requirement, potentially damaging the fastener, threads, or joined components.

title: Under-Torqued Fastener
description: A fastener was tightened below its specified torque or preload requirement, resulting in insufficient clamping force.

title: Cross-Threaded Fastener
description: A threaded fastener was started or installed incorrectly, damaging or misaligning the mating threads.

title: Incorrect Adhesive / Sealant
description: The wrong adhesive, sealant, bonding agent, or compound was used compared with the specified process requirement.

title: Missing / Insufficient Adhesive
description: Required adhesive, sealant, lubricant, or bonding compound is absent or applied in an insufficient amount or coverage pattern.

title: Excessive Adhesive / Sealant
description: Too much adhesive, sealant, lubricant, or bonding compound was applied, creating excess material or interfering with other components.

title: Seal / Gasket Defect
description: A seal, gasket, O-ring, or sealing element is damaged, incorrectly sized, missing, improperly seated, or otherwise unable to perform its sealing function.

title: Contamination
description: The part or assembly contains unwanted oil, grease, dust, chips, metal particles, foreign material, moisture, or other contamination.

title: Foreign Object / Debris
description: An unintended physical object or piece of debris is present inside, on, or around the part or assembly.

title: Corrosion / Oxidation
description: Unwanted corrosion, rust, oxidation, discoloration, or chemical degradation is visible on the component or assembly.

title: Coating / Plating Defect
description: A required coating, paint, anodizing, plating, or surface treatment is missing, damaged, uneven, incorrectly applied, or outside specification.

title: Paint / Finish Defect
description: The cosmetic finish has defects such as runs, drips, bubbles, peeling, incomplete coverage, incorrect color, or visible finish irregularities.

title: Weld Defect
description: A weld contains an unacceptable condition such as cracking, porosity, undercut, incomplete fusion, excessive spatter, or insufficient penetration.

title: Solder / Brazing Defect
description: A soldered or brazed joint has inadequate bonding, incomplete coverage, voids, contamination, cracking, or another unacceptable joining condition.

title: Electrical Connection Defect
description: An electrical connection, terminal, connector, crimp, wire, or contact is loose, damaged, incorrectly connected, or otherwise electrically unreliable.

title: Wiring / Routing Error
description: Wiring, tubing, hoses, or cables are routed incorrectly, improperly secured, excessively bent, or interfere with other components.

title: Functional Failure
description: The completed component or assembly does not perform its intended function when operated or tested under the specified conditions.

title: Leakage
description: A fluid, gas, air, hydraulic, pneumatic, or other pressure-containing system leaks beyond the permitted specification.

title: Alignment / Fit Issue
description: Two or more components do not align, mate, seat, engage, or fit together as intended, despite individual components potentially meeting their dimensional requirements.

title: Damage During Handling / Assembly
description: A component or assembly was damaged during handling, installation, transportation, or assembly, including dents, impacts, deformation, or accidental tool marks.

title: Incorrect Configuration / Revision
description: The product has been built, programmed, configured, or assembled according to an obsolete or incorrect drawing, specification, software version, or product revision.
